At $799 and about 650 W in its 40 TH/s mode, that's roughly 468 kWh a month — around $47 on your bill at under 12¢.

What you get for it: a draw at a full 3.125 BTC block every ten minutes, all year, and you still own the machine after every draw, plus steady sats to your own wallet meanwhile.

Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup?

context.pop: What do you pay for power? I'll run the Magic Miner 40T numbers for where you live.
